en:
Hey Shuichi. What's wrong?
You look so serious...

Is something bothering you?
We can talk about it if you want.
I'm just...worried, Rantaro.
Worried? What about?

About what you said before. That you're
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Useless Older Brother<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I told you...to forget about that.

I'm sorry, but I can't.
What did you mean by that?
Rantaro?
...Who cares about that?
What?

Hey, do you want to talk about my
talent? I still can't remember what it is!

I can tell you more about my
hobbies, if you'd like to hear.

<CLT=cltMIND>...There's that smile again.
It's a warning. He doesn't want me to push.
Y-Yeah, of course...

Thank you!
It really helps a lot, y'know?
You said traveling was your hobby, right?

Yeah. Before I was brought here,
I was traveling in Northern Europe.

Northern Europe? I imagine it's
something like a fairy tale.
Haha, yeah...

The cityscapes are gorgeous, but the nature
is the best part. Right out of a story book.

Although, the people... They seem friendly, but
when you get down to it, they're pretty aloof.

If the environment is harsh, perhaps the
culture developed that way as well.

Yeah, something like that. Like there was
one time I was trying to get some information...

I was suspected of being an informant
or something. Almost got taken out.

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? By "taken out"...
he couldn't possibly mean...

But South America? That's where you have
to watch out. There are a lot of shady areas.

But it's not all bad. You can get whatever you
want, if you're willing to take some risks.
Take some risks...?

Oh, don't ask. If I told you,
your life would be in danger.

...Why do you have so much
dangerous information, Rantaro?

Welp, that's just how
things played out.
<CLT=cltMIND>Just how it played out, huh?

Rantaro...I feel like you and I have
a very different definition of "travel."

Really? What do you think
of by "travel"?

I think about relaxing and touring
scenic locations...

Hey, I go sightseeing too. I travel
to see *everything*, y'know?

I suppose that includes all of that
"danger" you mentioned earlier...

...Ah!
Maybe that's it!
What's it?
Your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent!

You disguise yourself as a high school
student traveling around the world...

Maybe...you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Spy <CLT=cltNORMAL>
or something like that?

A spy, huh?
Hm, no, I don't think so...

I mean, if I were a spy, I wouldn't have told
you my identity. Or gotten caught like this.

Besides, I couldn't be anything cool
like that, look at me. I'm just a regular guy.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro is always smiling.
It's a gentle, friendly smile.
Something wrong?
No, it's nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>But right now, I feel like
that smile is a wall...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
